props.name: State
props.description: Visual and interactive state of the checkbox. Controls appearance and interactivity.

props.name: Selection
props.description: Selection state of the checkbox icon. Indeterminate indicates a mixed state in grouped checkboxes.

props.name: Indented
props.description: Adds a spacer before the checkbox to create visual hierarchy in nested checkbox lists.

props.name: Label
props.description: Shows or hides the top label element above the checkbox row.

props.name: Value
props.description: Shows or hides the inline text label displayed next to the checkbox icon.

props.name: Error message
props.description: Shows or hides the error message. Visible when State is Invalid.

props.name: Warning message
props.description: Shows or hides the warning message. Visible when State is Warning.

props.name: Helper message
props.description: Shows or hides optional helper text displayed below the checkbox row.

props.name: Show toggletip
props.description: Shows an information icon with toggletip tooltip next to the label.

props.name: Value text
props.description: Text content for the inline label displayed next to the checkbox icon.

props.name: Label text
props.description: Text content for the top label element.

props.name: Error text
props.description: Error message shown when State is Invalid.

props.name: Warning text
props.description: Warning message shown when State is Warning.

props.name: Helper text
props.description: Helper text shown below the checkbox when Helper message is true.

elements.notes: Container (3 children). Optional — controlled by 'Label' property.
Container (1 child). Optional — controlled by 'Helper message'. Hidden by default.

accessibility.keyboard: Space to toggle checked/unchecked; Tab to navigate between checkboxes
accessibility.notes: Use aria-checked with three values: true (checked), false (unchecked), mixed (indeterminate). The indeterminate state should only be set programmatically via aria-checked='mixed', not as a visual default.

do: Use checkboxes to allow users to select one or more options from a visible list
Use the indented variant to create visual hierarchy in nested checkbox lists
Display a helper message to provide additional context about the option
Use the label property for grouped checkbox sets to describe the group
dont: Do not use a checkbox when only one option can be selected — use a Radio button instead
Do not use a checkbox for a binary on/off action that takes immediate effect — use a Toggle instead
Do not use checkboxes as action buttons or navigation triggers
